newsitem.title: RUSSIA: TABLE-Russia C.Bank sells 579 bln rbls bills, bonds.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-Russia C.Bank sells 579 bln rbls bills, bonds.

text.p: The central bank sold 579.33 billion roubles nominal of GKO discount Treasury bills and OFZ interest-bearing government bonds on behalf of the Finance Ministry on Thursday, the bank's open-market operations department said.
The bank made the following transactions:

The bank did not say at what price the paper was sold. The 21076 issue closed on Thursday at 85.97 percent, the 21078 issue closed at 85.44 percent, the 21079 issue closed at 84.90 percent, the 21080 issue closed at 84.60 percent, the 21082 issue closed at 84.39 percent, the 23007 issue closed at 87.20 percent and the 24014 issue closed at 97.80 percent.

Apart from intervening on its own account for liquidity-smoothing and monetary policy purposes, the central bank buys and sells securities as part of its management of the Finance Ministry's debt and asset portfolio.
